text:
ashley: Heads-up — planning a mini-wave deploy (runtime + router + api) tonight 02:00 UTC. Low-risk, quick handback. Need pins, canary slice, and rollback triggers.

ben: ok, what's the canary % and region?

ashley: 5% EU first, then 20% global after 10m if metrics look good. Console will be read-only for schema writes during the first 5m.

mira: I need the console schema pinned to v2.3 for this window — console migrations still mid-rollout. If runtime pulls v2.4 it'll blow up rendering.

ashley: good call. pin runtime/model -> runtime-v5.1, api -> api-2026-03-22-rc1, console schema -> v2.3.

sre-ops: SRE notes: prewarm router pools 15m before the window, set eviction grace 30s, and enable fast-fail fallback to api-legacy if latency spikes. Rollback criteria: 2x error rate vs baseline OR P95 latency > 300ms for 5m.

ben: add that to the release notes. Also include quantization flag toggle note — ops will need to validate tokenization at canary.

mira: Adding the runbook snippet. Will flip console feature-flag to read-only via `ffctl set console.writes false` at T-5m and restore on successful ramp.

ashley: Deploybot, schedule the wave and pin artifacts. Include a manual hold step after canary for human sign-off (5m).

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: mini-wave-taxi-2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. Steps: (1) prewarm routers, (2) pin artifacts, (3) enable console read-only, (4) canary 5% EU, (5) wait 5m + sign-off, (6) ramp 20% global. Manual hold requested.

sre-ops: Telemetry to watch: error-rate, p95_latency, 50th_cpu, kv-eviction-count. I’ll add dashboards and set an alert: `alert if p95_latency > 300ms for 5m OR error_rate_ratio > 2`

ben: Who's on sig for the sign-off at 02:05?

mira: I can do console + api checks. ashley you take runtime and router?

ashley: yep I’ll watch runtime/router. If anything smells off we trigger rollback-runbook-quick (full unpin + route back to stable).

ben: release notes draft: "mini-wave taxi: bump runtime to v5.1, pin console schema v2.3, temporary read-only for schema writes, canary EU 5% then 20% global. Rollback if latency or errors spike. Prewarm router pools." I'll paste later.

mira: Also note: migration job scheduled T+30m to reconcile schema metrics — if that shows >0.5% failures we abort ramp.

ashley: final checklist: pins applied, deploybot scheduled, runbook linked, dashboards up, sign-offs assigned. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

mira: :thumbsup:

sre-ops: :thumbsup: Will attach alert links in the thread shortly.
